posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
Got some hints from Christopher. I’ve been banging my head up against them for a while, with no luck. Maybe someone else will figure out the secret!

1. It’s not about how you defeat Progeny, it’s about how you fight him. 

2. There are 2 parts that have to happen in the same fight. 

3. The first part has to do with sacrificing for your allies (but not health).  The second has to do with what Bunker is doing to switch Progeny’s form in the ARG. 

4. For BOTH of the halves, you’ll need the help of Megalopolis. 

 

Here is what I’ve tried, unsuccessfully. 

1. Having the environment kill Progeny, via monorails, cops, or redirecting damage from Targeting innocents (via Synaptic interruption or bouncing back as cold with AZ)

2. Having Bunker discard for/destroy every environment target or card. 

3. Winning with 3 Impending Casualties in play, never having gotten rid of them and using mega computers to mitigate the damage from leaving them out. 

4. Winning with every Environment Target in play. 

5. Playing 5 foam grenades, destroying 5 ongoings, 5 equipments, and discarding 5 cards. 

 

I’ll keep trying various things as I think of them. Hope these help someone get the unlock!

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Um, in the ARG, Bunker doesn't do anything to switch Progeny's form.  Progeny turns into Frost because AZ hits it with cold.  Presumably it would become Flame when hit with fire (but not apparently when it's already Frost), but that doesn't actually happen in the ARG.  Progeny only changes form twice in the ARG: once to defend against AZ's cold, and once as an opening move against the Prime Wardens.  Megalopolis only has two cards that can even affect Progeny: Police Backup and Plummeting Monorail.  Maybe Cramped-Quarters Combat or Rooftop Combat, interpreted generously.  None of any of this seems applicable.

As for sacrifice due to the environment, we've been playing around with that already.  Presumably he has to discard to feed various environment cards, Impending Casualty being the obvious one (since Bunker can be the only one to discard), but Paparazzi and Hostage might also count. Bunker could also lose an Ongoing to Impending Casualty instead, which seems like an odd choice since others would also be affected, but might explain why no one's gotten the unlock yet since that's almost always a dumb move.

OK!

I just got it, and I’m pretty sure I’ve got the missing component. 

The key for Bunker is damage rotation. It doesn’t matter what form Progeny is in, what Bunker has to do is constantly be changing damage types. 

I saved all the civilians, discarding mode cards preferentially (not sure if that is a component).  I sacrificed equipment to the Beginning of the End, though I couldn’t manage to get Bunker to pay for a full 5 equipment sacrifice in one go. 

For the damage rotation, I shifted types every time, never attacking with the same type twice. I didn’t worry about form (I used projectile against ice, fire against fire, energy against storm, etc). If I couldn’t switch types, I drew cards or healed until I could do so. 

There were several turns where I used the same type within that turn (Fire, projectile, energy, projectile).  

Hope this helps.
